latest.title: Keyboard, controller, online status, and Bluetooth readiness
latest.summary: OkamaOS now treats keyboard input as a first-class system path, broadens generic HID controller detection, shows live online and update status, refreshes the shell with a cyber grid background, and verifies system update hashes.
notes: Adds full keyboard shell navigation and developer terminal readiness.
Broadens generic USB and Bluetooth HID controller detection.
Shows live Ethernet/Wi-Fi internet state and OS/game update availability in the shell.
Starts Bluetooth in auto mode for plug-and-play controller readiness.
Verifies downloaded system update bundles with SHA-256 metadata.
